entry_state: The reference stack is a convenience choice,with committed books in one transactional store and analytical files derived. Persistent identities,versions and conditional results survive aggregation. Exact requests bind settings,views and expected heads;operation disposition differs from validity. Failed mass2/5 remains in the result and bounds the example mean104–116. Corrections create new views and invalidate candidate-set dependencies without rewriting history. Durability,migration and restart have observable obligations requiring runtime tests. Plugin declarations expose material inputs;solver unknown means unresolved coverage,not infeasibility.
exit_state: Review acceptance belongs to a stated layer;source correction and extraction correction differ. Evidence,model,run and economic-event identities have separate scopes. Adapter designs preserve typed contexts and original bytes. Hidden PDF text,empty page placeholders,skipped OCR and missing dependencies can survive successful returns. OTSL local syntax does not guarantee rectangular merged cells. Arelle transformed values already include numeric scale and sign;rawValue is assembled text,not original spelling. Section13.13.1 continues after348 with value validation and further identity distinctions.

findings.observation: The review examples distinguish accepting an extraction from accepting accounting treatment,and original source correction from OCR repair. Identity rules tie retries to economic events rather than run labels.
The extraction cases give concrete preservation requirements while separating source inspection from runtime performance or general accuracy claims.
Inline transformation and continuation examples show why returned text cannot substitute for original source bytes and loader diagnostics.
